title: Nonexistence conjecture for dendrimer nanostars of at least four stages
statement: A **dendrimer nanostar** is the nanostar structure obtained by growing a dendrimer through a specified number of stages; a graph is a **$G_\phi$-graph** if it is realized as $G_\phi(A)$ for an appropriate set $A$, using the Euler $\phi$ function as in the paper. **Nonexistence conjecture for dendrimer nanostars.** There is no dendrimer nanostar which has grown at least four stages, as a $G_\phi$-graph. The paper proves that the two-stage nanostar $D_2$ is a $G_\phi$-graph, while reporting that attempts to prove nonexistence for nanostars grown through at least four stages have failed; the conjecture remains open.
